ChampionMatchup.title: ChampionMatchup
ChampionMatchup.description: The player's record against one enemy champion in their lane.

LiveGames.title: LiveGames
LiveGames.description: Games roster players are in right now, as of the worker's last check.

LiveParticipant.title: LiveParticipant
LiveParticipant.description: One of the ten players in a live game, with what HexTrack knows about them.

LuckInsights.title: LuckInsights
LuckInsights.description:
Unlucky losses (lost, but scored >= high_threshold) and lucky wins (won, but scored
<= low_threshold), from games scored by the active model.

MatchAiExplain.title: MatchAiExplain
MatchAiExplain.description:
Why one player's stat line in one game got its AI Score.

``features`` use the ``FeatureAttribution`` fields for a single game: ``mean_attribution``
is this game's effect (logits at the base score; x ``b(1-b)`` x 100 = AI Score points),
``player_value`` the game's value. The effects add up to ``score - base_score``.

MatchupInsights.title: MatchupInsights
MatchupInsights.description:
Nemesis champions. The lane opponent is the enemy with the same ``team_position``;
games where the position is UNKNOWN / empty or not exactly one per team are skipped.

ProfileStats.title: ProfileStats
ProfileStats.description: Season aggregates over ranked queues (420, 440), remakes excluded.

RecordEntry.title: RecordEntry
RecordEntry.description: One game holding a record (or a pentakill game).

Records.title: Records
Records.description:
Single-game records. Scope "roster" = all tracked players; "player" = only ``puuid``
(tracked or not). best_kda needs at least 5 takedowns; highest_kill_participation needs
at least 10 team kills; highest_ai_score only uses active-model scores. A record must be
above zero. longest_game and fastest_win list each match once (the friend with the
lowest participant id).

ScheduleInsights.title: ScheduleInsights
ScheduleInsights.description: Best time to play: win rate by local day of week and hour of game start.

ScheduleWindow.title: ScheduleWindow
ScheduleWindow.description: Three consecutive hours on one day of week (never crossing midnight).

SessionInsights.title: SessionInsights
SessionInsights.description:
Tilt detector. A session = consecutive ranked games of the player where
``next.game_start - (previous.game_start + previous.duration) <= gap_minutes``.

SquadPair.title: SquadPair
SquadPair.description:
Two roster players who played ranked games on the SAME team.

Duo synergy: ``games``/``wins``/``winrate`` of their shared games, compared with
``expected_winrate``. Who carries whom: over ``scored_games`` (shared games where both
have an active-model score), how often a's score was higher / lower / equal to b's.

SquadPlayer.title: SquadPlayer
SquadPlayer.description: One tracked (roster) player's totals in the requested period.

StackGame.title: StackGame
StackGame.description: One team in one match on which ``size``+ roster players played together.

StackLineup.title: StackLineup
StackLineup.description: An exact set of roster players (sorted puuids) and their record together.

StackPlayer.title: StackPlayer
StackPlayer.description: A roster player's numbers across the stacks in the requested scope.

StackVerdict.title: StackVerdict
StackVerdict.description: Banter verdict for one stack: teammates share the result, so their scores compare.
